references.text: Another place in the Torah that gives the command to make tassels (tzitzit) on garments
The command to bind God's words as a sign on the hand and forehead, reminding one to remember all the Lord's commands
The command for signs on the hand and between the eyes as a reminder of the Lord's law
Warning against letting the heart be led astray to turn away and worship other gods
Words of wisdom about keeping the eyes looking straight ahead and not being led astray
Warning to follow the ways of the heart and what the eyes see, but remembering that God will judge
The prophet's words about Israel committing spiritual adultery with idols in their hearts and with their eyes
Job makes a covenant with his eyes so that he does not let his gaze lead him into sin
John warns against the lust of the eyes as part of the world's desires
James describes how desire lures and drags people away from God
Paul writes about the mindset of the flesh versus the mindset of the Spirit
Paul urges believers to walk in the Spirit and not fulfill the desires of the flesh
Jesus notes that the Pharisees make their prayer straps and tassels large to be seen by people
